biological_interpretation: CBP has a thalamic neuronal output that is not shared acutely by the KAT3 paralog p300.
caveats: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut also had the largest Crebbp perturbed-cell count, and Crebbp mRNA was not significantly depleted in any class.
The Crebbp response occurred despite weak measured Crebbp transcript depletion, and Ep300 engagement was also weak.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Crebbp perturbation produced its corrected response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, where an excitability-associated branch including Rbfox2, Stmn4, and near-threshold Kcnq2, Scn1b, Kctd17, Nrn1, and Kcnc2 was down-regulated; Ep300 remained weak and near-zero correlated with Crebbp. Parquet-verified leading rows: Crebbp->Stxbp2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC 1.06, FDR 5.01e-04; Crebbp->Rtn4rl1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.617, FDR 0.024; Crebbp->Dgkz in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.46, FDR 0.0472; Crebbp->Ccdc141 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.35, FDR 0.0472; Crebbp->Rbfox2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.471, FDR 0.0472; Crebbp->Leng8 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC 0.248, FDR 0.0472.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.summary: Detected Crebbp response was concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the only Crebbp cell class with FDR-significant genes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The strongest Crebbp output in this dataset is a restricted thalamic glutamatergic state rather than a uniform consequence across all assayed Crebbp-positive neuronal classes.

finding_summaries.summary: Ep300 and Crebbp did not behave as interchangeable KAT3 paralogs in the shared cell types; Crebbp alone produced a corrected 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut response and their whole-signature correlations were near zero.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: p300 and CBP are often grouped biochemically, but their perturbation signatures in this brain dataset should not be merged or assumed equivalent.

resolved_evidence.description: On-target Crebbp transcript abundance was not significantly reduced in any context where the target transcript was measured.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Crebbp target row detected in 8 cell-type contrasts; n_pert_matched=20-61; Crebbp logFC range -0.586 to 0.048; nominal p range 0.0697-0.823; pvals_adj=1.0 in all 8 contrasts.

resolved_evidence.description: Only the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class had a multiple-testing-significant Crebbp transcriptional response.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: 61 perturbed cells, 23679 controls, 8 genes FDR<0.05, 16 genes FDR<0.10, min FDR=0.000501. The seven other Crebbp cell types had 20-37 perturbed cells each and 0 genes FDR<0.05; their min FDR values ranged from 0.110797 to 1.0.

resolved_evidence.description: Whole-transcriptome Ep300 and Crebbp signatures were nearly uncorrelated in every shared cell type.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Eight overlapping Ep300 and Crebbp cell types; Pearson correlations were -0.0005, -0.0160, 0.0207, 0.0320, 0.0902, 0.0387, 0.0475, and -0.0127; maximum Pearson correlation was 0.0902 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

title: Crebbp loss alone lowers a thalamic excitability branch among KAT3 paralogs
